claims.claim: NEAR Intents is the largest swap venue with more than 50% of volume, whether volume is taken as reported or one side of each swap is counted for every venue.
Most of the year-on-year volume gain came from taking share, not from market growth.
The peer-set market itself grew more than 25% year on year.
Intents charges at least the median take rate of its rivals (it is not winning on price alone).
NEAR keeps more than 50% of the gross fees Intents generates.
The lead is stable: weekly share never fell below 40% in the last 26 undistorted weeks.
When its largest rival stopped trading, Intents picked up more than 33% of the flow that rival had carried.
Intents daily volume is steadier than every rival's (lower standard deviation relative to its mean).
The share of fees reaching NEAR rose in every one of the last 4 consecutive 90-day windows.
No single distribution channel carries more than 33% of 1Click swap volume.
Intents is also the largest venue when the four big bridges are added to the peer set.

subject_methodology.Fees: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators.
subject_methodology.HoldersRevenue: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.
subject_methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Captured revenue held by the treasury before the 2026-02-23 buyback program.
subject_methodology.Revenue: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded.
subject_methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Gross fees minus NEAR's captured revenue - the affiliate fees kept by solvers and third-party distribution channels (e.g. SwapKit).

predictions.text: NEAR Intents still holds at least 50% of peer-set volume over the trailing 90 days.
NEAR's captured revenue is at least 30% of gross Intents fees over the trailing 90 days.
The Intents take rate has not been competed below 12 bps over the trailing 90 days.
